item.description: <h2 id="introduction">Introduction </h2><p style="text-align: justify;">At <b><a href="https://defcon.org/html/defcon-33/dc-33-index.html" target="_blank">#DEFCON33</a></b>, one of the most prestigious security conferences in the world, <b><a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/nmmorette" target="_blank">Natan Morette</a></b> presented the <b><a href="https://www.cvehunters.com/" target="_blank">CVE-Hunters</a></b> project, which represents a fundamental change in the way we approach cybersecurity education, transforming the classic dilemma of lack of experience into a concrete learning opportunity.</br></br>With 116 published CVEs, 170 discovered vulnerabilities, and 20 active members in less than a year, <b><a href="https://www.cvehunters.com/" target="_blank">CVE-Hunters</a></b> is a replicable model that is changing lives and improving the security of systems used by millions of people.</br></br>During his classes, <b><a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/nmmorette" target="_blank">Natan</a></b> constantly faced the same question:</p>
